_source: Lifted from the inline `themes` map in getPersonalYear() in apps/api/src/modules/numerology/numerology.service.ts. Keyed by the computed personal-year number (1..9). Drives the theme/description/career/finance/relationships/health narrative. English only at seed time; 11 other locales filled by `npm run kb:backfill`.
_shape: { theme: string, description: string, career: string, finance: string, relationships: string, health: string }

en.description: A year of fresh starts, independence, and planting seeds. Take initiative on projects you've been dreaming about.
en.career: Launch new ventures, seek promotions, or pivot careers. Leadership opportunities arise.
en.finance: Start new investments. Bold financial moves are favored. Avoid debt.
en.relationships: New connections form. Existing bonds deepen through honest communication.
en.health: Start new fitness routines. Energy is high — channel it positively.

en.description: A year of cooperation, diplomacy, and nurturing relationships. Patience brings rewards.
en.career: Collaborate, don't compete. Partnerships and team projects succeed.
en.finance: Steady growth through partnerships. Avoid risky solo investments.
en.relationships: Deep bonding year. Marriage or commitment decisions favored.
en.health: Focus on emotional wellness. Meditation and yoga balance your energy.

en.description: A year of self-expression, joy, and social expansion. Your creativity peaks.
en.career: Creative projects shine. Public speaking, writing, and media opportunities.
en.finance: Income through creative channels. Marketing investments pay off.
en.relationships: Social life blooms. New friendships and romance possibilities.
en.health: Good vitality. Watch for overindulgence in food and drink.

en.description: A year of building solid foundations through discipline and persistence.
en.career: Steady work pays off. Focus on systems, processes, and skill-building.
en.finance: Save and invest conservatively. Build financial foundations.
en.relationships: Stability in relationships. Work through challenges with patience.
en.health: Establish consistent health routines. Don't neglect rest.

en.description: A year of major changes, travel, and breaking free from limitations.
en.career: Career shifts likely. Embrace change — it leads to growth. Travel for work.
en.finance: Variable income. Trading and quick returns possible. Diversify.
en.relationships: Dynamic energy in relationships. Avoid impulsive commitments.
en.health: Stay active. Adventure sports and travel rejuvenate you.

en.description: A year centered on home, family, love, and taking responsibility.
en.career: Service-oriented work thrives. Real estate and home-based businesses favored.
en.finance: Home-related expenses. Investments in property or family businesses.
en.relationships: Marriage, engagement, or deepening family bonds. Love blooms.
en.health: Focus on nutrition and home cooking. Domestic harmony heals.

en.description: A year of inner wisdom, research, and spiritual development.
en.career: Research, analysis, and specialization. Quality over quantity.
en.finance: Avoid major financial risks. Study investments carefully.
en.relationships: Introspection in relationships. Quality connections over quantity.
en.health: Mental health priority. Meditation, therapy, and nature walks.

en.description: A year of material achievement, power, and karmic rewards.
en.career: Big career moves. Promotions, business expansion, and authority.
en.finance: Financial breakthrough year. Large transactions and investments.
en.relationships: Power dynamics in relationships. Balance giving and receiving.
en.health: Strong constitution. Watch for stress-related issues.

en.description: A year of endings, humanitarian service, and preparing for a new cycle.
en.career: Complete major projects. Mentor others. Philanthropy expands influence.
en.finance: Charitable giving. Release what no longer serves you financially.
en.relationships: Forgiveness and closure. Some relationships may naturally end.
en.health: Detox and renewal. Let go of unhealthy habits.
